claims.statement: Tom Allen and Joe Goss fought a draw about nine years before 1876, when Allen was comparatively young.

claims.statement: Billy Edwards said that Tom Allen would beat Joe Goss without trouble in a fair fight.
claims.excerpt: Allen will whip Goss without trouble.

claims.statement: Jem Mace said that Joe Goss would win the fight barring all accidents.
claims.excerpt: Goss will win the fight barring ali accidents.

claims.statement: Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards thought that, if the fight came off, Goss might put it off for at least four months.
claims.excerpt: it will be staved off by Goss for four months at least.

claims.statement: St. Louis sporting men had the utmost confidence in Tom Allen, the home champion.
